type Options = {reason: string};
type Envelope<T> = T;
export const inOrder = async <T,>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: Envelope<Options> & {trace: boolean}) => {
 for (const item of items) { await step(item); }
};
export async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: Required<Options>) {
 for (const step of steps) { await step(); }
}
